searchText: It seems to me that greater scaling is achieved when utility tokens stop being a thing and ETH is just used for the incentives and fees because the utility tokens create demand for decentralized exchanges and this exchanging activity is whats causing a high consumption of blockspace. I imagine this problem will sort itself over time tho and scaling solutions and dapps that use ETH will win in terms of actual users over those that have their own tokens. But lets see The challenge with using Eth only for a dapp is governance and raising money. If you are just using Eth, then your governance is likely centralized and you will probably need offchain funding for development. Notably, Uniswap was basically using the model you suggest and Sushiswap was able to take a lot of liquidity from it. Hoping this fits here.
